name: Helldivers 2
notes: nProtect GameGuard works via Proton, but DO NOT force GE-Proton — recent reports show anti-cheat crashes with GE; leave the Steam default (Valve keeps this game on Proton Hotfix and patches breakage within a day). Very CPU-intensive — NTSync greatly improves frame pacing. AMD: force_dx11 resolves VKD3D regressions on RDNA and pairs well with DXVK Async; note the new in-game upscalers (FSR3) only work on the DX12 path, so it's DX11 smoothness vs DX12 upscaling. NVIDIA: DX12/VKD3D is generally stable and NVAPI unlocks DLSS.
